notes.title: Update 2025.03.08 02
notes.content:
FACE LOVE: Face Designer small update

Changes:

Toggle fullscreen / window resolution from the main menu


Bugfixes:

If you delete all the faces from your Face Library you can still access Creative Mode. If you deleted all your faces before this update, you must save at least one face in tutorial mode for the fix to take effect.

notes.title: HOTFIX - 2025.03.08 01
notes.content:
Patch 2025.03.08 01 - black screen hotfix
Changes:

Attempts to fix the black screen on boot for some users. If you previously submitted a bug report, please resubmit if the issue persists.

notes.title: OUT NOW: FACE LOVE Face Designer!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401050/FACE_LOVE_Face_Designer/

HEY- WHERE DID EVERYBODY'S FACES GO?

Well, it's time to build 'em new ones.

FACE LOVE: Face Designer is out now for free along with paid DLC more stuff for FACE LOVE.



You can make faces for random customers at the face factory, or head to Creative Mode to design the face of your nightmares- er- dreams..

Make sure to use the in-game photo tool to take screenshots of your creations, and share them to the Steam Community Hub. The people must see what you've created!

Also share your screenshots with @LimboLaneGames on Instagram, X, Tumblr, Bluesky, or TikTok

Let's get cracking!
